name: Used NVIDIA RTX 3090 24GB - Dec-2026 refresh asking band

notes: VERDICT CHANGE vs the Oct-2026 record: at $1,430-2,220 asking the used 3090 is NO LONGER the obvious budget pick it was at ~$950.
